description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Ninja Slice Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Ninja Slice Mode
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient), casts Callous Blade after using two Samurai abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
